supporting_quotes.exact: The API models the camera subsystem as a pipeline that converts incoming requests for frame captures into frames, on a 1:1 basis.

observations.subject: camera subsystem
observations.object: a pipeline that converts frame-capture requests into frames on a 1:1 basis

claims.rationale: claim 的核心断言（流水线建模 + 请求到帧的 1:1 转换）逐字出现在引文中；来源 aosp-camera-hal3 为 Camera HAL3 架构文档，引文中的 'The API' 即指 Camera HAL3 API。完整支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL. Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL).

observations.subject: camera HAL interface development
observations.object: AIDL from Android 13; HIDL-defined stable interface since Android 8.0 Treble

claims.rationale: 引文两个分句与 claim 两句陈述一一对应：'Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL' 与 'Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL)'，时间、版本（13/8.0）、技术（AIDL/HIDL）均一致。完整支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: The HAL sits between the camera driver and the higher-level Android framework and defines an interface that you must implement so apps can correctly operate the camera hardware.
Android's camera hardware abstraction layer (HAL) connects the higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to your underlying camera driver and hardware.

observations.subject: HAL
observations.object: camera driver and higher-level Android framework, defining an interface for apps to operate camera hardware

observations.subject: HAL
observations.object: Camera 2 framework APIs to underlying camera driver and hardware

claims.rationale: 两条同源（aosp-camera-architecture）引文分别覆盖 claim 的两部分：证据 d937f440c251 直接支持 '位于 camera driver 与更高层 framework 之间' 与 '定义必须实现以让应用正确操作相机硬件的接口'；证据 8a33cfacf842 支持 '向上连接 Camera 2 框架 API' 并再次确认与底层 driver/hardware 的连接。两引文为同一文档的不同表述，互相一致，无冲突。完整支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: Android 9 introduced API support for multi-camera devices through a new logical camera device composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction. The logical camera device is exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app allowing for interaction with HAL-integrated multi-camera features.

observations.subject: logical camera device
observations.predicate: introduced in Android 9 as composed of
observations.object: two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction, exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession

claims.rationale: 引文逐项支持 claim：'Android 9 introduced API support'（版本）、'composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction'（构成）、'exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app'（对应用呈现方式）。完整支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: Most of this information is a static property of the camera subsystem and can therefore be queried before configuring any output pipelines or submitting any requests.

the new camera API adds a substantial amount of dynamic metadata to each captured frame. This includes the requested and actual parameters used for the capture, as well as additional per-frame metadata such as timestamps and statistics generator output.
For most settings, the expectation is that they can be changed every frame, without introducing significant stutter or delay to the output frame stream.

observations.subject: camera metadata (static)
observations.object: a static property of the camera subsystem, queryable before configuring output pipelines or submitting requests

observations.subject: dynamic metadata
observations.object: requested and actual capture parameters plus per-frame timestamps and statistics output

observations.subject: settings (control)
observations.object: every frame without significant stutter or delay to the output frame stream

claims.rationale: 三条同源引文分别对应三类元数据：evidence-ccd5ac3651b7 支持 'dynamic 随每帧生成并含实际使用的参数与时间戳'（引文还含 requested 参数与 statistics 输出，与 claim 不矛盾）；evidence-5fc4b7551293 支持 'control 设置预期可每帧修改而不引入明显卡顿或延迟'（引文说 'For most settings'，claim 未保留该限定，属轻微差异）；evidence-ec5493ad2bf0 支持 '静态、可在配置输出管线或提交请求前查询'，但 claim 中 '描述传感器特性' 的表述在引文中仅为 'a static property of the camera subsystem'，未提及 'sensor' 或'传感器特性'，且引文以 'Most of this information' 限定比例而 claim 未保留。故判定为部分支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: A hardware abstraction layer (HAL) is type of abstraction layer with a standard interface for hardware vendors to implement. A HAL allows hardware vendors to implement lower-level, device-specific features without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers.
HIDL enables communication between HAL clients and HAL services.

observations.subject: HAL
observations.object: an abstraction layer with a standard interface for vendors, allowing lower-level device-specific features without affecting higher-level layers

claims.rationale: 引文 d8e44be806f4 完整支持 claim 前半部分（标准接口、硬件厂商实现、不修改更高层代码），引文 ffb3b59c768e 支持 HIDL 用于 HAL client 与 HAL service 之间通信。两引文同源且各自独立对应 claim 的两个分句，无冲突。注：引文原文为 'is type of abstraction layer'（缺冠词，系源文如此），不影响语义对应。完整支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: Most tests in VTS are GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation.

observations.subject: VTS tests
observations.object: GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation

claims.rationale: 引文 'Most tests in VTS are GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation' 与 claim 核心断言逐字对应（VTS 中大多数测试为检查 HAL 实现的 GTest 风格测试）。claim 中 'VTS (Vendor Test Suite)' 为来源 aosp-vts 所指代缩写的标准扩写，引文未写出全称，但不影响核心断言。完整支持。

supporting_quotes.exact: hardware devices are modelled as an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads.

An entity is a basic media hardware building block. It can correspond to a large variety of logical blocks such as physical hardware devices (CMOS sensor for instance), logical hardware devices (a building block in a System-on-Chip image processing pipeline), DMA channels or physical connectors.

observations.subject: hardware devices
observations.object: an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads

observations.subject: entity
observations.object: physical devices (e.g. CMOS sensor), SoC image processing pipeline building blocks, DMA channels, physical connectors

claims.rationale: 引文 d3551866bc58 支持 '把硬件设备建模为通过 pad 连接的 entity 图'（原文为 oriented graph，即媒体控制器建模，来源 kernel-v4l2-mc 即 media controller 文档）；引文 0267a563245f 支持 'entity 是基本媒体硬件构建块，可对应 CMOS sensor、SoC 图像处理流水线、DMA 通道等'，与 claim 逐项对应。两引文一致，无冲突。完整支持。
